items.period: Modern reconstruction; not a dated artifact
items.caption: A modern vector reconstruction of 真 in Shuowen seal-script style. Shuowen’s traditional parsing of 眞 differs from competing analyses of the Western Zhou bronze forms.
items.alt: Black seal-script style graph with a tall left stroke, curved upper stroke, rounded central enclosure containing two horizontal bars, and two descending lower strokes.
items.selection_reason: Offers a sourced example of the received seal-script form for comparison with the separately described bronze forms, without presenting the later Shuowen interpretation as settled bronze-era history.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on the Commons file page.

limitations.text: This is a modern reconstruction, not an ancient artifact image. Its shape and Shuowen parsing do not settle the origin or original meaning of the Western Zhou bronze graph; no image was visually inspected during this research pass.
